warning.titlePre: Jaguar F-Type P450 Timing Chain Tensioner Wear
paragraphs: If your F-Type P450 has the AJ133 5.0-litre supercharged V8 — the engine fitted across the X152 generation — timing chain tensioner and guide wear is a documented pattern on this engine family, with the 2012–2014 model years explicitly named in the same US class-action lawsuit scope as the XJ, XK and XF. We replace timing chains, tensioners and guides as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via rrsport.co.uk lawsuit reference per G-BRF and VRF. Applies to the AJ133 engine family; the F-Type P450 is part of this scope.
